mandate.quote: 5슬리브를 z스코어로 컴포짓해서 탑20 뽑는 전략으로 프로즌없이 전 기간 백테해서 현재 pg2랑 성과 비교해봐

design.z_score_kr: Per sig_date cross-section z (Iter5 1715 score_eff + NEW alpha)
design.z_score_tsmom: Rolling 36m z-score on monthly return (PIT lag 1m)
design.z_score_kr_10y: Rolling 36m z-score on monthly return (PIT lag 1m)
design.top20_selection: Cross-universe rank by composite_z descending → top 20 EW 5% each

comparison_table_4axis.header: PD22 vs 3 PG2-related baselines (same-period where possible)

rows.strategy: PD20-B Path 2 aligned (4-sleeve consolidation z-composite KR equity)

diebold_mariano_vs_s4_v2.interpretation: PD22 underperforms S4 v2 but NOT statistically significantly (t=-0.09). Mean monthly returns are essentially same, but PD22 has much higher variance (vol_ann 22.5% vs S4 v2 ~10%) + MDD.

structural_reasons_for_failure.evidence: Mean 19.71/20 slots = 98.5% KR stocks. Universe size disparity (770 vs 9 non-KR candidates) makes ETF/Bond effectively excluded from cross-universe ranking.
structural_reasons_for_failure.impact: Sleeve hedging diversification 효과 0 — PD22 effectively becomes KR-only stock-picking 18-20 stocks EW 5% each.

structural_reasons_for_failure.evidence: Cross-universe top20 selection ignores sleeve weight ratios (50/25/20/5). Effective post-selection weights are EW 5% × top20.
structural_reasons_for_failure.impact: S4 v2's multi-asset hedging (KR bond + TSMOM strategy basket) cannot moderate KR equity exposure during crises.

structural_reasons_for_failure.evidence: PD22 MDD -33.60% vs S4 v2 MDD -12.63%. Difference 20.97pp.
structural_reasons_for_failure.impact: Without sleeve hedging structure, 위기 시 100% KR equity exposure → stagflation 2022 / COVID 2020 등에서 휘말림.

structural_reasons_for_failure.evidence: Cross-universe ranking churn 629% annualized vs S4 v2 ~60%. Cost drag 188 bps/yr vs S4 v2 ~18 bps/yr.
structural_reasons_for_failure.impact: Cost drag alone consumes 1.88pp of CAGR annually. PD22's SR_gross 0.84 vs SR_net 0.74 = 0.10 cost drag drag points.

structural_reasons_for_failure.evidence: PD22 EW 5% each → STR_1715 anchor stock (e.g., 삼성전자) weighted 5% instead of 6.83% (STR_1715 PG2 weighting).
structural_reasons_for_failure.impact: Top 1715 alpha stocks의 z-weighted concentration gain 상실. Diluted to flat 5%.

interpretation_A_pd20b_path2.instantiation: 5-sleeve weighting을 z-composite로 활용 — sleeve weighting 자체가 composite. KR equity sleeve = composite top20 z_1715+z_NEW; TSMOM/KR_10y/Cash sleeve weights inherit (22.5/18/4.5).
interpretation_A_pd20b_path2.result: PD20-B Path 2 SR 2.31 MDD -14.58% — sleeve hedging 보존

interpretation_B_pd22_cross_universe.instantiation: 5-sleeve 모든 자산을 cross-universe ranking → top20 select
interpretation_B_pd22_cross_universe.result: PD22 SR 0.74 MDD -33.60% — sleeve hedging 상실
interpretation_B_pd22_cross_universe.verdict: Universe size dominance 문제로 multi-asset 다양화 효과 100% 상실

design_critique_dohoon_framing.conclusion: 도훈 framing의 정확한 정량 instantiation은 interpretation A (PD20-B Path 2). interpretation B (PD22)는 단어 그대로 해석 가능하나 결과적으로 sleeve weighting 무용지물.

forge_verdict.rationale: 4-axis strict improve test ALL FAIL vs S4 v2 baseline + ALL 3-axis FAIL vs PD20-B Path 2 + ALL 3-axis FAIL vs PD18 5-sleeve. Diebold-Mariano t_NW -0.09 (Harvey 3.0 FAIL). Cross-universe ranking mechanism collapses to KR-only stock-picking due to universe size dominance (770 vs 9). Multi-asset hedging diversification 효과 100% 상실. MDD -33.60% (vs -12.63% S4 v2) → 4-axis strict floor 위반.
forge_verdict.recommendation_primary: Retain current PG2 admit (S4 v2 4-sleeve hybrid 50/25/20/5cash from WT-P20260509_001, 5/12 effective). No change to operational portfolio.
forge_verdict.recommendation_secondary: Pending PD21 Judge re-spawn (composite-level DSR/Harvey/4-axis validation), consider upgrade to PD20-B Path 2 (4-sleeve consolidation) — SR 2.31, MDD -14.58%, currently 'CONDITIONAL_ADMIT' status from PD20 governor cycle.

key_learning_l_code_candidate.title: Cross-universe ranking ≠ sleeve hedging (universe size dominance penalty)
key_learning_l_code_candidate.context: WT-D20260511_001 PD22 — 5-sleeve cross-universe z-composite top20 design 백테스트
key_learning_l_code_candidate.finding: Universe size disparity (770 KR vs 9 non-KR) makes cross-universe ranking collapse to KR-only stock-picking. 5-sleeve weighting structure가 사라지면 multi-asset diversification 효과 100% 상실. Sleeve hedging 본질은 weighting itself.
key_learning_l_code_candidate.evidence: PD22 SR 0.74 MDD -33.60% vs S4 v2 SR 1.83 MDD -12.63%. 4-axis ALL FAIL. PD20-B Path 2 (sleeve weighting 보존) SR 2.31 dominate.
key_learning_l_code_candidate.policy_implication: Multi-asset 5-sleeve strategy의 z-composite는 sleeve weighting을 composite로 활용 (PD20-B Path 2 instantiation) — sleeve 자체를 ranking universe로 합치는 cross-universe 방식 부적격.
